description: This file defines a RecyclerView ViewHolder class used in the Android client for Nextcloud Notes. The class binds a view item and sets up a click listener to create a public share link.

classes.name: NewLinkShareViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder that binds a public share item view and sets up a click listener to trigger creating a share link.

methods.name: NewLinkShareViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view holder with a view or binding.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a ShareeListAdapterListener to the view, setting up a click listener to create a public share link.
